Pickles

One refrigerator brine works for sliced vegetables. Keep pickles chilled; add pomegranate fresh and pair it with pickled red onion.

Master refrigerator brine

For about 2 cups sliced vegetables

½ cup vinegar
½ cup water
1 tsp salt
Optional: 1 tsp honey

Warm just enough to dissolve the salt. Pour over vegetables in a clean jar, cool, cover and refrigerate. Taste after 30 minutes; flavor deepens overnight.

Use red-wine, rice, apple-cider, champagne or other preferred vinegar. For strict gluten avoidance, verify specialty vinegar labels.

Vegetable guide

Red onion · all-purpose; especially good with fresh pomegranate.

Cucumber · Asian bowls, tuna, salmon.

Julienned carrot · shrimp, tofu, spicy bowls.

Radish · salmon, Mediterranean bowls.

Jalapeño · Mexican, tofu, spicy salmon.

Cauliflower · Mediterranean bowls.

Green beans · tuna, Italian bowls.

Celery · tuna and chicken scoops.

Pair it simply

Onion + pomegranate

Fresh pomegranate, pickled red onion, feta, walnuts and parsley.

Cucumber + dill

Smoked salmon or sprats, dill, toasted sesame, yuzu or rice vinegar.

Jalapeño + corn

Turkey or tofu, smoky corn, avocado and mint-forward Mexican mint used sparingly.
